host.authorizeTitle: Allow this issue to use this agent
host.authorizeBody: Allow authorized participants in this issue, including those who join later, to submit instructions to this agent and control its executions in this issue. Execution uses the selected runtime's AI account and tool permissions, as ordinary tasks do.
host.access: This issue uses a separate session and working directory. The directory is not an operating-system sandbox; the agent can still access host files, accounts, and tools allowed by its ordinary configuration.
host.stopScope: Stopping prevents further dispatch in the selected scope and requests cancellation of executions already started within that scope. Cleanup follows ordinary task behavior and does not guarantee removal of background processes outside the managed scope.
host.reauthorize: The execution mode or tool permissions changed. The resource owner must confirm this issue's authorization again. Waiting instructions are retained; resuming still requires an explicit action.
host.stopRequested: Stop requested; waiting for the runtime
host.stopOffline: Runtime offline; stop not yet confirmed
host.cleanupBestEffort: Managed execution ended and cleanup was attempted; background processes outside the managed scope were not verified
host.cleanupTracked: Cleanup confirmed within the managed scope
host.unknown: Execution state unconfirmed; cannot resume yet
host.disconnected: Connection interrupted; host execution may still be running
host.resumed: Resumed; the next eligible batch will be processed
host.upgrade: Upgrade this client to control this execution mode
host.newSession: The previous session could not be resumed; a new session was created from this issue's records
host.unavailable: Collaboration execution is unavailable for this runtime

resources.noWorkspaces: No resource workspaces are available to your account.
resources.noCandidates: No matching resources are visible in this workspace.
resources.empty: No AI targets have been registered.
resources.purpose: Each resource owner must already be a participant and authorize their own resources for this issue. Authorization does not resume execution.
resources.consentPurpose: Allow all current and future participants of this issue to use this resource under its current configuration.
resources.withdrawEffect: New work using this resource will be blocked. Running work will be asked to stop; waiting inputs and history will remain.
resources.ownerRequired: Invite the resource owner as a participant before registering this target.
resources.ownerUnavailable: The resource owner is unavailable. Refresh the participants before trying again.
resources.alreadyRegistered: This target is already registered. Refresh the resources to see it.
resources.registrationRequired: This runtime needs a valid collaboration registration before it can be authorized.
resources.registered: Target registered. Each owner must authorize their resources.
resources.authorized: Resource authorized. Explicit resume is still required.
resources.withdrawn: Authorization withdrawn. This does not confirm that running work has ended.
resources.proposeHint: Select the same target in its resource workspace to review its current agent and runtime configuration.
resources.commitEffect: The server will verify every owner consent and confirm old work has ended. Waiting inputs keep their target; the new configuration remains held until you resume it.
resources.proposed: Switch proposal created. Collect each owner's consent before applying it.
resources.switchConsent: Proposal consent recorded. The live configuration has not changed.
resources.switchWithdrawEffect: This consent cannot be restored on this proposal. A new proposal will need new consent.
resources.switched: Configuration switched. Explicit resume is still required.
resources.pauseRequired: Pause this target and wait for its previous work to end before applying the proposal.
resources.offerDescription: Offer a resource you own for this collaboration. The creator or handler can adopt it; each owner then authorizes their resource.
resources.offerConfirmation: After adoption, each resource owner must authorize their resource before this collaboration can use it.
resources.withdrawOfferEffect: Withdraw this offer before it is adopted. Authorization for an adopted resource is managed in its resource controls.
resources.offerAdopted: Resource adopted. Each owner can now authorize their resource.
resources.staleOffer: This resource offer has changed. Refresh it before confirming again.
resources.notOwned: You can only offer a resource you own.

memory.title: Shared context
memory.description: The current state of this issue, kept up to date by agents across machines and accounts. Participants who can control AI may correct it.
memory.empty: No shared context yet. Agents add findings, decisions and next steps here as they work.
memory.overLimit: Over the current limit. Shorten it.
memory.editHint: Rewrite the whole document as the current state. Detailed history belongs in comments.
memory.tooLong: This is over the {{max}}-byte limit. Shorten it before saving; your text is kept.
memory.conflict: Someone updated the shared context after you started. Your text is kept. Review the current version, merge your changes, then save again.
memory.invalidContent: The text contains unsupported characters. Remove them and save again.
memory.closed: This issue is closed, so its shared context is read-only.
memory.purged: The text of v{{version}} was purged.
memory.currentNotPurgeable: The current version cannot be purged. Edit the shared context first.
memory.refused: The server did not apply this change. Refresh and try again.
memory.pendingUpdate: Saving the shared context is not confirmed.
memory.viewPurged: The text of this version was purged. Its size and writer remain in the history.
memory.restoreBody: This saves the text of v{{version}} as a new version. Later versions stay in the history.
memory.purgeBody: The text is removed permanently and cannot be restored. The version number, size and writer remain, with a purged marker.
memory.purgeReasonRequired: Enter a reason of up to 1,000 bytes.
